lead: A `.nvst` case that names a variable `$argv` collects a second diagnostic the case never asked for.
body: `rule:statements/no-host-populated-variables` refuses every host-populated name, so the line carries `E0211` *as well as* whatever it was written to pin, and an `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` block written for one error a line silently needs two. Spell an argument list `$words` or `$parts` in a case; that rule's own table is the reserved set.
